overview: The Oshkosh Police Department (OPD) is using Flock Automatic License Plate Readers (ALPRs) to help detect and reduce crime in our community. Flock ALPRs are stationary ALPR cameras located within Municipal - Right of Ways and are self-sufficient. They are powered by solar panels and send image information through government-standard encrypted cell signals. The ALPRs capture objective evidence without compromising individual privacy. The OPD utilizes retroactive searches to solve crimes after they have occurred. These cameras are not used for speed enforcement. Additionally, OPD utilizes real-time alerting of hotlist vehicles to capture wanted criminals and missing endangered children and adults. To ensure proper usage and guardrails are in place, the OPD has our policies and usage statistics available to the public here on the OPD website at https://www.oshkoshpd.com/
shares_data_with: Oshkosh WI PD [INACTIVE] is not sharing data with any partner networks.

acceptable_use: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Oshkosh WI PD and is never sold to 3rd parties.
prohibited_uses: Immigration enforcement, speed enforcement, harassment or intimidation, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), Personal use.
access_policy: All system access requires a valid reason and is stored indefinitely.
hotlist_policy: Hotlist hits are required to be human verified prior to action.
